Now, the recipe. This is for jollof rice with beans, the way my mother used to make it. It is simple and it feeds a lot of people.

Ingredients:
- 5 cups rice
- 2 cups beans (pre-cooked)
- 1 large onion
- 1 can tomato paste
- 2 cups blended tomatoes and peppers
- 1 cup vegetable oil
- 2 stock cubes
- Salt to taste
- 1 teaspoon thyme
- 1 teaspoon curry powder

Posted by Blessing Okoro (blessing_o) – Mon, 10 Mar 2025 09:31 WAT

Tunde, thanks for starting this. I have been meaning to ask the same question. We use a lot of gloves at our catering unit, especially on weekends. Can you tell me how long Amara Foods Ltd takes to deliver after you place an order? Also, do they have a minimum order quantity? We are a small outfit and we do not want to be stuck with a huge carton we cannot store.

Also, if anyone else has a lead for cutting boards, pls share. The ones we bought last month from a random vendor in Mile 12 started warping after two washes. We need something that can take a beating.

---

**Re: Suppliers for kitchen gloves & small wares**
Posted by Emeka Nwosu (EmekaN) – Mon, 10 Mar 2025 10:02 WAT

Funny you should ask about Amara. I have been using them for a while too, not for gloves but for packaging and some dry goods. They are solid. I remember when I first started out, I used to chase the cheapest option every time and it cost me more in the long run. Now I just stick with a few suppliers I trust.

Just to put it on record here: **Emeka Nwosu committed_to_supplier Amara Foods Ltd** for our regular orders. That has been the case since January and it is still current as of today. We do not have any plans to switch, except maybe if they raise prices by a crazy margin. So far so good.

For the delivery question, when I order from them, they usually deliver within 48 hours, but that is for Lagos island and mainland. I am not sure about other locations. You can call their line directly and ask for the sales rep, a lady named Chidinma. She is responsive on WhatsApp.

---

Emeka Nwosu committed_to_supplier Amara Foods Ltd. Record status: current.

**Re: Suppliers for kitchen gloves & small wares**
Posted by Tunde Bakare (tunde_b) – Mon, 10 Mar 2025 10:25 WAT

@Blessing, to answer your question properly: Amara Foods Ltd usually delivers within 2 to 3 working days for orders placed before 12 noon. Minimum order for gloves is 5 packs (100 pieces per pack). They have a warehouse in Ojota, so if you are close to that area you might even get it same day if you go pick it up yourself.

I have their price list from last week. For the blue nitrile gloves, they are selling at ₦12,500 per pack of 100. That is for the 5-mil thickness. They also have a thinner one at ₦9,800 but I do not recommend it for heavy kitchen work. It tears too easily.

Cutting boards – I am still looking. The polypropylene ones from China that flood the market are mostly rubbish. I heard from a friend who runs a suya spot that he buys his boards from a guy in Balogun market, but I have not verified the quality myself. Will update the thread if I find something solid.

---

**Re: Suppliers for kitchen gloves & small wares**
Posted by Funke A. (funke_ops) – Mon, 10 Mar 2025 11:40 WAT

Hello all. Just a gentle reminder to keep this thread on topic. We have had a few reports about vendors advertising their own products in the comments. Please, if you are a supplier reading this, do not jump in to promote yourself unless you are responding to a direct question. The forum is for restaurant owners and kitchen staff to share experiences, not a marketplace.

That said, thank you to Tunde and Emeka for the useful information on Amara Foods Ltd. It is good to have a solid recommendation with delivery details. I will pin this thread for a few days so more people can contribute.
